# I Am Your Beast Archipelago
## State of the mod
This mod is still a work in progress and it's in an early alpha stage. The currently implemented features should work, but there are still many things in development.
### What is part of this mod?
Currently the main unlocks for the game are the levels. All four collections of the game can be included and each level unlocks one by one in a random order. The **Completion Goal** is to beat a certain number of levels. The amount can be chosen by the player. Optionally it is possible to add extra challenges, such as achieving certain amounts of S Ranks or completing Bonus Objectives on the levels.
Optionally Death Link is also supported.

The **Locations** are the following:
* Level completions
* S Ranks
* Bonus Objectives
* Hidden Snowmen
* Level Pickups

The **Items** you can receive are Levels, Traps and Filler items. There is also an option to lock the Weapons behind items.

### Future plans

* Minimal & Gliched logic.
* Proper and better looking UI for Archipelago.

## Setup Guide
## If you are hosting
1. Download and install [Archipelago](https://github.com/ArchipelagoMW/Archipelago/releases).
2. Open Archipelago
3. Download `i_am_your_beast.apworld` from the [releases page](https://github.com/petiboy7/IAYBArchipelago/releases). Clicking on the APWorld should automatically install it to Archipelago.
4. Download `IAmYourBeast.yaml` from the [releases page](https://github.com/petiboy7/IAYBArchipelago/releases) and place it in the Players folder
5. Edit `IAmYourBeast.yaml` to change any options you may want
6. Make sure you have everyone's APWorld and yaml installed and click generate
7. Go to [Upload Multidata](https://archipelago.gg/uploads) and start the server.

## If you are playing
1. Download and install [r2modman](https://r2modman.com/download-latest/)
2. Open r2modman and from the game selection choose I Am Your Beast
3. Create a new profile and click on _Select Profile_. Go to _Mods => Online_ and find the 'Archipelago' mod and download the latest version.
4. Start the game from r2modman with **Start Modded**. Once the game opens you can connect to your Archipelago session by typing the Address, Slot name and Password on the top left of the screen.

## Contact
If you have any kind of feedback, suggestions, question or bug reports join the [Archipelago Discord server](https://discord.com/invite/archipelago) and find the I Am Your Beast room under Future game design.

notes.text:
# I Am Your Beast Archipelago 0.3.4

## Improvements

### APWorld
- Changed the `.yaml` description to add missing information and make each option easier to understand.
- Added a new option to exclude Horde levels from the pool.
- Added a new option to change Map Type to show armor items on the map.

### Mod
- Level names are always visible on the level select screen.
- Cutscenes are hidden by default on the level select screen. Can be toggled on or off.
- Added a button to only show levels that are available on the level select screen. Can be toggled on or off.
- Optionally added armor items to the map. Can be changed in the YAML settings.
- When connecting to Archipelago from the Menu, all items are resynced with the server and all checks that are done in your save file but were never sent are sent. The game might freeze for a while when connecting if there are a lot of these.

## Fixes

### Mod
- Weapons are now visible on the minimap when weapon randomization is not enabled.
- *Maybe* fixed Bonus Objective locations not sending properly. Again.

## Note

**This version is not compatible with already hosted multiworlds.**
